scope: Request-local context evidence reuse; text and metadata only, no synthesized audio.

compatibility.metadata_reference_kind: v0.18 implementation compatibility; not independent linguistic approval

report_integrity.validation: counts, text exact flags, reference fields/order, all summary metrics, stable files

external_development_regression.note: Known Sproat training development prefix; not held-out accuracy. External raw data/results are not vendored.

remaining_limits: After two partial token mutations a unit uses the existing uncached path, which still repeats scope scans.
Open/nested quotes, literals and delimiter-heavy pending scans need separate worst-case bounds.
No improvement in linguistic coverage or independent reference approval claimed.

caveats: Includes CLI startup, resource loading, normalization and stdout collection.
Not TTFB or audio evaluation; not a hardware-independent or general-linear claim.
Timeouts are censored observations, not completed latency measurements.
Counter suffixes exercise partial-token invalidation; this cost may remain nonlinear.
stdin uses one context unit until flush; input chunks are at most 65536 bytes.
No warm-up; each repetition starts a fresh process; before then after are interleaved.
